title: Midas Test
tagline: A decentralized prototype and designs testing platform where testers get paid for their contribution to product designers
description: Midas test is a dApp that will serve as a testing platform where designers can upload their project prototypes and let testers test them in order to receive MATIC rewards. Designers will create projects and set an investment amount which will be divided into the total quantity of testers that completes the test. We didnt get to finish the UI but the smart contract is all working and you can see the whole prototype in here: https://marvelapp.com/prototype/hh2cgb7/screen/85008468 And the github repo for the smart contract is in: https://github.com/LuisRivera1699/midas-test-hardhat
how_its_made: This project uses solidity for the smart contract where we coded the logic of the dApp platform. It was built on hardhat framework and was deployed to a local network to perform testings. For the frontend we used Reactjs and Vitejs. The wallet accepted for the platform is Metamask and the connection with the smart contract is built with ethers library. It is uploaded to testnet, so youll need funds to interact with the project and contract.
